papers.title: Maternal RSV Vaccination, Infant Nirsevimab, or Both: Interim Analysis of a Randomized Trial.
papers.abstract: Although both maternal respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) prefusion F vaccination (RSVpreF) and infant nirsevimab immunization have been approved for the prevention of RSV lower respiratory tract infections, the 2 have not been evaluated in a single study, and their sequential administration has not been studied systematically. We performed a prospective, randomized, open-label, phase 4 study at 8 US sites of mother-infant pairs randomized 1:1:1:1 during pregnancy: maternal RSVpreF vaccine alone, maternal RSVpreF vaccine/infant nirsevimab at birth, maternal RSVpreF vaccine/infant nirsevimab at 3 months, or infant nirsevimab alone at birth. We are following the mother-infant pairs for 12 months to ascertain safety, infant tolerability, and the magnitude and durability of RSV-A and -B neutralizing antibodies (nAbs). We report interim data from September 19, 2024, to May 15, 2025, including 4-month infant follow-up. In total, 181 mothers were enrolled. Both products alone and in combination were safe. No related serious adverse events were observed in mothers or infants. Nirsevimab was well tolerated, and all local and systemic reactogenicity was mild to moderate in severity. RSVpreF vaccination boosted maternal RSV-A nAb titers 17.35-fold at the time of delivery, and titers were durable through 3 months postdelivery. The geometric mean transfer ratio of RSV-A nAbs was higher than 1.3 and similar across groups. RSV nAbs were highly elevated in infants at 6 weeks and 3 months, irrespective of group, with modest differences in waning. Maternal RSVpreF vaccine and infant nirsevimab administration, either alone or in combination, were safe and provided high RSV nAb titers in infants through interim follow-up.
papers.summary_ja: 母体RSVpreFワクチンと乳児ニルセビマブの単独・併用はいずれも安全で、乳児期を通じて高い中和抗体価を維持した（RCT中間解析, 181例）。

papers.title: Late Outcomes Following Acute Kidney Injury in Children: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
papers.abstract: Acute kidney injury (AKI) is a common complication among hospitalized children and may have lasting kidney and cardiovascular consequences. However, the long-term risks after pediatric AKI have not been comprehensively quantified. Of 17 068 screened records, 39 studies comprising 16 151 participants were included. The pooled cumulative incidences following AKI were 17% (95% CI, 12-22) for CKD, 6% (95% CI, 3-8) for mortality, 20% (95% CI, 12-29) for proteinuria, and 16% (95% CI, 11-23) for hypertension. In 23 studies with non-AKI comparators, AKI was associated with increased odds of CKD (OR, 1.74; 95% CI, 1.02-2.95) and mortality (OR, 1.92; 95% CI, 1.35-2.75). Greater AKI severity was associated with a higher odds of CKD (stages 2-3: OR, 2.84; stage 1: OR, 1.72).
papers.summary_ja: 小児AKI後はCKDリスク1.74倍・死亡リスク1.92倍で、重症度が高いほどリスク増大（39研究、16,151例のメタ解析）。構造的長期フォローが必要。

papers.title: Safety of Sildenafil in Premature Infants with Severe Bronchopulmonary Dysplasia (SILDI-SAFE): A Randomized Controlled Trial.
papers.abstract: To describe the safety of sildenafil based on hypotension in premature infants with bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD). A total of 122 infants received sildenafil (N=92) or placebo (N=30). The incidence of hypotension did not differ between the sildenafil (1/92) and placebo (0/30) groups. Serious adverse events occurred in 8% of the sildenafil group and 13% of the placebo group; retinopathy of prematurity requiring treatment in 17% and 30%, abnormal hearing results in 8% and 7%, escalation in respiratory support in 7% and 20%, respectively.
papers.summary_ja: 重症BPD合併の在胎29週未満早産児（122例）において、シルデナフィルは低血圧増加なく安全で、ROP・呼吸悪化もプラセボ以下であった。

papers.title: The Bayley-4 Versus the Bayley-III in Very Preterm Children at 24 Months' Corrected Age.
papers.abstract: Bayley-4A&NZ standard scores are lower than Bayley-III scores. Adjusted mean difference estimates between standard scores on Bayley-4A&NZ vs Bayley-III were cognitive -10.3 (95% CI [-11.9 to -8.8]), language -5.9 (95% CI [-7.6 to -4.1]), motor -3.7 (95% CI [-5.2 to -2.2]). Cognitive scores more than 2 standard deviations below the mean occurred in 12.8% of Bayley-4A&NZ group vs 4% of the Bayley-III group. Adjusted relative risk ratio 4.0.
papers.summary_ja: Bayley-4はBayley-IIIより認知スコアが平均10.3点低く、修正24ヵ月での「重度認知遅滞」検出率が4倍に増加する（1,034例の前向きコホート）。

papers.title: Cash Transfers in the Perinatal Period and Investigations of Infant Maltreatment.
papers.abstract: Infants are most vulnerable to child maltreatment, in part due to poverty during the perinatal period. After implementation of Rx Kids in 2024, the investigated allegation rate decreased to 15.5% in Flint, falling below the rate of 20.6% among the control cities. Rx Kids was associated with a statistically significant 7.0-percentage-point decrease (95% CI, -12.9 to -1.0; P=.02) in the investigated allegation rate, corresponding to a 32% decrease relative to the preintervention period.
papers.summary_ja: 周産期・乳児期の現金給付プログラム（Rx Kids）実施で乳児虐待通報率が32%（7ポイント）有意に低下し、経済的支援が虐待防止に有効であることが示された。

papers.title: Efficacy and Safety of Rituximab Therapy to Sustain Remission in Young Children With Childhood Nephrotic Syndrome.
papers.abstract: We conducted a retrospective cohort study at 16 pediatric nephrology centers from 10 countries in Asia, Europe, and North America. One hundred one children (70 boys) received their first rituximab courses at the age of 4.5 (IQR: 3.6-5.4) years, with an observation period of 4.6 (IQR: 3.2-6.6) years. The median relapse-free survival after the first rituximab treatment was 8.8 (95% CI: 7.5-11.0) months. Each additional month of concurrent immunosuppression post-rituximab reduced relapse risk by 8%. Rituximab should be reserved until established treatments are exhausted.
papers.summary_ja: 6歳未満の頻回再発/ステロイド依存性NS 101例へのリツキシマブは寛解維持に有効だが、合併症リスクがあり他薬試験後に使用すべき（16施設10カ国）。

papers.title: Efficacy and Safety of Telitacicept in IgA Vasculitis Nephritis: A Single-Center Retrospective Study.
papers.abstract: A retrospective analysis was conducted on clinical data from patients aged 3-18 years with IgAVN treated with telitacicept. A total of 16 patients were enrolled. At 12 months, mean 24h-UP decreased to 0.16±0.15g (P<0.001), with 68.75% of patients achieving complete remission. No serious adverse events occurred.
papers.summary_ja: IgA血管炎性腎炎の小児16例へのテリタシセプト（BAFF/APRIL二重阻害）は12ヵ月で68.75%に完全寛解、重篤有害事象なし。

papers.title: Aluminium Adjuvants in Vaccines and Potential Health Effects: Systematic Review.
papers.abstract: High quality evidence from randomised controlled trials and large cohorts consistently showed no association between aluminium adjuvanted vaccines and serious or long term health outcomes, such as asthma, autism spectrum disorders, or other chronic conditions. Studies on macrophagic myofasciitis were generally small and methodologically limited. Current evidence does not support causal associations between aluminium adjuvanted vaccines and serious or long term health outcomes.
papers.summary_ja: 59研究のSRでアルミニウムアジュバント含有ワクチンと喘息・ASD・慢性疾患の因果関係は否定され、局所肉芽腫（0.1%未満）以外の安全上の懸念なし。

papers.title: Considerations for the Clinical Use of Teplizumab in Stage 2 Type 1 Diabetes: A Consensus Statement from the British Society of Paediatric Endocrinology and Diabetes (BSPED) and the Association of British Clinical Diabetologists (ABCD).
papers.abstract: In 2025, the MHRA approved the use of teplizumab to delay progression from Stage 2 to Stage 3 Type 1 diabetes in the UK. Here, we present recommendations on all aspects of teplizumab administration with evidence base where available, including safety considerations in individual selection, screening, monitoring and treatment of potential common side effects.
papers.summary_ja: 英国BSPED/ABCDがステージ2 1型糖尿病へのテプリズマブ（抗CD3抗体）の適応選定・投与・副作用管理の包括的コンセンサスを提示。

papers.title: Parent-Mediated Early Intervention in Infants and Toddlers at Elevated Likelihood for Autism: A Systematic Review of Randomized Controlled Trials.
papers.abstract: A systematic literature search from 2014 until 17 February 2025 was performed. Papers were selected based on RCT studies with mean age of children enrolled ≤18 months and infants presenting autistic signs or at elevated likelihood for ASD. Eleven studies were included and analyzed in regard to sample characteristics, enrollment strategies, outcome measures and intervention types.
papers.summary_ja: 生後18ヵ月以下のASDリスク乳児への親媒介型早期介入（11 RCTs）は前診断的アプローチとして有望だが、均一なエビデンス確立にはさらなるRCTが必要。

papers.title: Four-Year Neurodevelopmental Outcomes in Infants with Symptomatic Congenital Cytomegalovirus Disease Treated with Oral Valganciclovir: A Prospective Follow-Up Study in Japan.
papers.abstract: This prospective follow-up study (VGCV-2) included 24 infants with symptomatic congenital CMV disease who received oral VGCV (16 mg/kg, twice daily for 6 months). At 4 years, developmental delay was evident in 28.6% of patients. Neurodevelopmental disorders including intellectual disability (28.6%), ASD (19.0%), and cerebral palsy (14.3%) were diagnosed in 42.9% of patients.
papers.summary_ja: 症候性先天性CMV感染症の乳児24例にバルガンシクロビル6ヵ月投与後、4年時点で42.9%に神経発達障害が残存。出生時聴力・頭囲が予後予測因子（日本）。

papers.title: A Randomized Controlled Trial of Ultrasound-Assisted Versus Traditional Landmark Lumbar Puncture in the Neonatal and Infant Population.
papers.abstract: We analyzed 95 LPs performed in 91 infants by 16 proceduralists. First-attempt non-traumatic success occurred in 50% of LPs in both groups (OR, 1.00). Procedure time was longer in the ultrasound group (mean 25.9 vs 17.9 minutes; P=0.002). Ultrasound assistance improved success within 2 attempts among less experienced proceduralists.
papers.summary_ja: NICU乳児（91例）への超音波補助腰椎穿刺はランドマーク法と初回成功率で差なし（50% vs 50%）。未熟な施術者では2回以内成功率が改善する可能性あり。

papers.title: Contemporary Surgical Management of Preterm Intraventricular Hemorrhage in North America.
papers.abstract: This prospective North American observational cohort included 700 infants with preterm IVH who underwent neurosurgical evaluation. Despite severe ventriculomegaly, observational approach was initiated in 68% of cohort. Surgical temporization occurred in 45%. Overall, permanent CSF diversion was required in 67%. Significant center variation in the proportion of infants undergoing temporary and permanent CSF diversion was observed.
papers.summary_ja: 早産児IVH700例で永続的CSF治療が67%に必要となり、施設間での手術タイミング決定に大きな差が確認された（前向き北米コホート）。

papers.title: Impact of a Shared Pediatric Palliative Care Program on End-of-Life Care Trends Among Children: A 10-Year Retrospective Study in Taiwan.
papers.abstract: This retrospective cohort study included 294 children who died between 2008 and 2017 at two medical centers in southern Taiwan. Following implementation of a shared PPC program in 2011, DNR documentation increased from 59.2% to 73.9% (p=.03). Documented family meetings rose from 4.1% to 18.2% (p<.001), and PPC consultations increased from 7.1% to 23.9% (p<.001). ICU deaths remained high (87.8-89.8%).
papers.summary_ja: 台湾2施設での共有型小児緩和ケアプログラム導入後、DNR記録率・家族会議率・緩和ケア相談率が有意に改善したが、ICU死亡率は依然高い（294例、10年間）。

papers.title: Clinical Outcomes of the 2022 AAP Hyperbilirubinemia Guideline in Term and Late-Preterm Infants: A Prospective Study in Thailand.
papers.abstract: We conducted a prospective observational study including 1,104 neonates ≥35 weeks' gestation. Phototherapy was required in 221 infants (20.0%), representing a 38% relative reduction compared with the 2004 guideline (32%; p<0.001). Readmission occurred in 127 infants (11.5%). No cases of acute bilirubin encephalopathy or exchange transfusion were reported.
papers.summary_ja: 2022 AAPガイドライン適用で光線療法率が38%減少（32%→20%）、急性ビリルビン脳症・交換輸血ゼロを維持。中所得国での適用可能性を支持（1,104例）。
